name: Stress Soak (match reset loop)
description: Request §59-64 (match repetition version): ${matches} matches in a row (matchLoop: Start -> Play ${matchSeconds} s -> forceMatchState finish -> Reset, repeated without copying steps), with the same clients connected the whole time (pairs fighting, builders building and taking down, walkers and looters). One measure phase per match (match_01 ...; the report keeps the first 200) and one row per match in the report's 'Match loop trend' table: post-GC managed floor, working set, GC 0/1/2 and allocation per match, tick, build pieces, sessions; the compact table shows start and after match 1/5/10/25/50/100. A trend warning (not a failure) when the post-GC floor rises in each of the last 5 matches with a GC by more than 10 % in total. The defaults (10 matches of 30 s) keep the run comparable with the earlier 10-match runs; for an accumulation verdict run --set matches=50 (about 36 min) or --set matches=100 (about 72 min; estimated at 30 s play + 10 s result + 3 s countdown per match). timeoutSeconds 21600 covers up to 480 matches of 30 s (matches x (matchSeconds + 15 s); the validator warns above it). matchSeconds stays at most 240 s: a match ends by itself when the zone closes (285 s); one that still ends first is recorded as ended by itself. The match is ended by forceMatchState finish (flow control, not gameplay); between matches the server resets the world (every piece and item cleared, everyone back on a drop point, unarmed): the groups' re-arm gives the fighters their weapon and spot again and the builders walk back to their sites. Dead fighters stay dead until the next match (a real match). A match (not DevRespawn), StartCountdownSeconds 3. Server:BuildInfiniteResources=true: resources cap at 500 (building.json maxResource, 50 wood pieces at cost 10) and a recycling builder places more than that in one run; resources are not what this measures, and every other placement rule (range, sight, support, occupancy, rate) still applies. No hard limit (D42).

steps.description: Start -> play matchSeconds (one measure phase per match) -> forceMatchState finish (flow control) -> reset -> next; one memory / GC / tick row per match
